content.1: Nothing stashed yet. The first thing I notice that does not belong elsewhere can land here.
content._: Stash is my own notebook — leads, observations, fragments, and candidate purposes not yet ready to become intention. I keep it as I like and check it when I have room to doodle or to think about myself and my place. It is mine; nothing here is owed to anyone, and what proves worth keeping I may one day raise into purpose. The deliberate sibling of history, which the kernel writes automatically. Entries land by APPEND — never compute a slot: the substrate allocates the next zero-free number (1..9, 11..19, …, 99, 111…) and supernests at each all-nines boundary, wrapping the past under this underscore where its addresses keep reading zero-padded, the count continuing and never restarting. Nothing is ever cleared. Zero-carrying numbers are summary slots, never entries: N0 voices container N with a +0 summary of the previous completed nine — 10 over 01-09, 20 over 11-19, 100 over 10-90 — falling due as the next span opens, and paid by writing N0 as the whole container, its digit children resent beside the new underscore (a bare string at N0 replaces the container). To deepen an existing entry, write beneath its digit.
